anya: heads-up — saw a 3x tail latency bump on canary around 15:02 UTC. root cause looks tied to KV evicter under sustained long-context workloads :thinking_face:
marco: can you dump the timeline? which policy was enabled? LRU or FIFO?
liz: saw similar overnight on a different shard, maybe fragmentation + reuse failure.
anya: fifo on that rollout (we were testing FIFO to reduce churn). timeline attached below.
anya: ```
2026-02-14T15:02:08Z INFO evicter: pressure=0.92 active_allocs=32768 reuse_hits=23 reuse_misses=179
2026-02-14T15:02:08Z WARN pager: paged_out=4096 paged_in=4095 latency_ms=12.4
2026-02-14T15:02:09Z INFO evicter: policy=FIFO batch_size=64 evicted=4096
2026-02-14T15:02:09Z ERROR runtime: stall_detected backend_wait_ms=180
```
marco: thanks. can you also paste a perf flame or pprof top?
anya: grabbed a short perf from the pod — top shows a lot of time in evicter::reinsert(), and some in kv::pager::scan_range() 
anya: ```
# pprof top (sampled)
45.2%  evicter::reinsert
18.6%  kv::pager::scan_range
9.4%   runtime::sleep_until
7.1%   io::read
```
devon: that reinsert % is high. FIFO reinserts a lot when hotset oscillates, which can cascade when paging starts.
liz: could be fragmentation causing reinserts to miss because entries split across slabs. we saw a similar pattern with long-context customer traces — memory grows then bursts of evict+reinsert.
marco: hypothesis: FIFO + large batch evictions push many entries into pager at once; pager then scans, causing stall and heap thrash which causes additional evicts -> latency spike.
anya: I reproduced locally with a synthetic workload (long prefixes + many small KV entries). attaching repro script snippet.
anya: ```bash
# stress-kv.sh (repro)
for i in {1..200000}; do 
  seq=\$(printf "%04d" $((i % 8000)))
  curl -s -X POST $CANARY_URL -d "prefix=longcontext-$seq&tokens=2048" >/dev/null
done
```
perf-bot: uploaded flamegraph to thread — link: https://internal.redwood/perf/ffg/1765432199
devon: quick mitigation options? lower FIFO batch_size, enable adaptive-backoff, or revert to LRU on canary.
marco: can we try lowering batch_size to 16 and enable staggered pager windows? that should reduce the cascade.
liz: also add a metric for reinserts/sec + fragmentation_ratio so we can alert before a spike.
anya: will push a hotfix to canary: batch_size=16, pager_window_ms=20, enable reinsertsampling=true. rolling out in 5.
marco: after the roll, keep an eye on reuse_hits and page-in stalls. if we still see >150ms backend_wait, revert to LRU and run full profiler.
anya: rolled to canary. baseline after change: reuse_hits up from 23->410, pager latency steady ~3.1ms, tail backend_wait dropped to 22ms.
liz: nice. please still schedule a deeper correctness test for FIFO reinserts — we need unit tests for slab-splitting edgecases.
devon: i'll add a fuzz test that randomizes slab sizes + eviction order.
marco: tracking action items:
- anya: keep canary config and capture 24h of metrics (reinserts, fragmentation_ratio, pager_latency)
- devon: craft fuzz test for slab split/reinsert correctness
- liz: implement fragmentation_ratio metric + alert
- marco: prepare rollback plan to LRU if regressions appear

anya: ping me if anyone needs the canary pod logs, I kept them at /tmp/canary-1765432199.log :thumbsup:
marco: thanks everyone, great triage. :rocket:
